record.reason: AgentCL is a benchmark and memory-probing framework for non-parametric inference-time learning; it notes agents spend substantial inference time and measures cross-task reuse/stability, but it does not report reduced inference tokens, calls, latency or serving cost. Given its linked agent-memory lineage and a plausible but unverified reuse-to-efficiency connection, retain as borderline.
record.title: AgentCL: Toward Rigorous Evaluation of Continual Learning in Language Agents
